data.title: Increase of share capital in connection with the share option programme and subscription results
data.description: The Board of AS Tallink Grupp has decided to boost the Group's share capital by EUR 2,451,661 by issuing new ordinary shares. This decision was made in relation to the utilization of options granted under the share option scheme endorsed by the Group's General Meeting of Shareholders on June 13, 2023. The increase in share capital aligns with the stipulations outlined in the share option programme.

data.title: Echion Technologies signs MOU with Korean total battery solutions provider Energy Tech Solution to grow the XNO® battery manufacturing ecosystem
data.description: An international partnership is set to expedite the integration of XNO® into the advanced battery sector to assist high-intensity industrial clients. The collaboration between Echion Technologies and Energy Tech Solution was unveiled on September 15, 2026 in London. Through a memorandum of understanding (MoU), the two companies aim to leverage their expertise to propel XNO®'s presence in the market and cater to the needs of industrial users requiring robust energy solutions. This strategic alliance is anticipated to significantly enhance XNO®'s position and boost its offerings in the advanced battery industry.

data.title: Rx Networks Brings TruePoint.CM Enterprise-Grade NRTK to the Americas
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, Rx Networks, a company specializing in GNSS assistance and correction services, revealed the launch of TruePoint.CM, its Network RTK product in the TruePoint portfolio, in North America and Latin America. TruePoint.CM is tailored for professional and commercial users seeking precise centimeter-level positioning accuracy. It is particularly beneficial for fields like surveying, precision agriculture, mining, and construction. The product offers reliable solutions for users with specialized needs in these sectors.

data.title: Traefik Labs Introduces the Sovereign Trust Plane, Bringing Verifiable Evidence to AI Agent Governance
data.description: Traefik Labs unveiled the Sovereign Trust Plane (STP) in Traefik Hub, presenting a range of functions to enhance AI agent governance. Scheduled for widespread release by September 30, 2026, STP facilitates delegated access, policy enforcement, and secure documentation of gateway permissions regarding model, tool, and API traffic. This framework ensures accountability as agents engage in activities such as issuing refunds, accessing customer data, and modifying business records.

data.title: Thredd Selected by iPayLinks to Power New Virtual Commercial Debit Card Programme
data.description: In Singapore today, Thredd, an AI-focused issuer processing platform, revealed that iPayLinks, a prominent cross-border payment and capital settlement platform, has chosen Thredd to drive its upcoming Mastercard virtual commercial debit card initiative. Expected to debut by the conclusion of Q3, the program will enhance iPayLinks' cross-border services by enabling card issuing, providing customers with a rapid and safe method to transfer and utilize funds internationally. In this collaboration, iPayLinks functions as the primary  platform for launching the new virtual commercial debit card program.

data.title: Iron Mountain Partners with the Opéra national de Paris to Preserve and Digitize its Visual Heritage
data.description: The Opéra national de Paris, a key player in the performing arts industry for over 350 years, has joined forces with Iron Mountain (NYSE: IRM) to safeguard its history. Through this collaboration, the institution aims to preserve and digitize its visual collections, ensuring they remain accessible for future audiences. Leveraging Iron Mountain's extensive experience spanning 75 years and utilizing the Insight® DXP suite of solutions, the Opéra is poised to enhance the preservation and accessibility of its cherished heritage.

data.title: Quectel QLM290P Consolidates High-Precision GNSS, RTK and LTE Design Onto a Single Ready-to-Integrate Platform
data.description: In Munich, Quectel Wireless Solutions has launched the QLM290P, a smart antenna device combining high-precision GNSS/RTK positioning, LoRa connectivity, and global LTE connectivity, with direct access to RTK correction services, on a single pre-validated PCBA. This provides developers with an integrated platform for precise positioning and short- and long-range communications. Aimed at organizations developing robotics, the device offers a comprehensive solution for IoT applications.

data.title: Quectel Launches New IMU Sensor Modules to Help OEMs Reduce Risk and Accelerate Development and TTM
data.description: Quectel Wireless Solutions, a leading IoT solutions provider, unveiled today the expansion of its automotive-grade inertial measurement unit (IMU) line by introducing three new 6-axis modules. IMUs serve the purpose of enabling devices to perceive motion, tilt, and orientation autonomously, similar to a smartphone's screen-rotation sensor but tailored to a distinct standard. These new modules prioritize automotive-grade reliability and have been meticulously engineered to meet stringent standards.

data.title: JDEnergy Highlights the Value of String PCS for Spain's Energy Storage Market
data.description: In Xi'an, China, on September 15, 2026, JDEnergy organized a webinar focused on the Spanish energy storage sector. The event featured JDEnergy's technical and local sales teams collaborating with Spanish partner WDenergia. They discussed Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) technology, showcasing its practical applications in projects. The webinar aimed to provide insights on the current state of the Spanish energy storage market and foster collaboration between the companies involved.
